description: This file defines behaviors and functions for attaching, detaching, and managing text editors within the Drupal CMS editor module, including handling XSS filtering, format switching, and event management.

methods.name: findFieldForFormatSelector
methods.description: Finds the textarea DOM element associated with a given format selector.

methods.name: filterXssWhenSwitching
methods.description: Filters the textarea value for XSS safety by calling server-side filtering if needed.

methods.name: changeTextEditor
methods.description: Switches the text editor attached to a textarea based on the selected format.

methods.name: onTextFormatChange
methods.description: Handles the change event when a user switches text formats, including confirmation dialogs for content filtering.
